originalTitle: Indian Bank drops capital raising plan on lower ECL hit
simplifiedContent: Indian Bank was planning to sell shares to raise money, but it has now cancelled those plans. This is because the bank expects to lose less money from bad loans than it initially thought. As a result, the bank doesn't need to raise extra capital, which is why it's no longer selling shares. The bank's profit increased by 10% in the first quarter, and it also saw significant growth in loans and deposits. This change in plans is important because it shows the bank's financial situation is better than expected, which could affect investor confidence.

originalTitle: SK Hynix shares jump 14% in debut on US stock market riding on AI wave
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a big company that makes computer chips, just started selling its shares on the US stock market and they went up 14% on the first day. This means that many investors wanted to buy the company's shares, which is a good sign. The company wants to make more of a specific type of chip and invest in artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The strong demand for the shares shows that investors are interested in companies that are involved in AI, but some analysts are worried that the company's value might be too high and that people might stop spending as much on AI soon. This is important because it could affect the company's performance and the value of its shares.

originalTitle: Morgan Stanley warns AI chip rally may be running out of steam
simplifiedContent: Morgan Stanley's expert, Lisa Shalett, thinks that the recent increase in value of companies that make special computer chips for artificial intelligence (AI) might be coming to an end. She believes that these companies, known as chipmakers, might be overvalued because big tech companies are starting to make their own, cheaper AI chips. This could lead to slower spending on AI technology and less power for chipmakers to set prices, which could be a challenge for them. Despite this, investors are still interested in these companies, and one company, SK Hynix, is even listing its shares on the Nasdaq stock exchange. This warning from Morgan Stanley matters because it could affect the value of investments in these chipmaking companies.

originalTitle: Fino Payments Bank June update: Deposits rise 11%, loan referrals surge 3.5x
simplifiedContent: Fino Payments Bank recently shared an update on its performance. The bank's deposits, which is the money people have put into their accounts, grew by 11% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹2,755 crore. The bank also opened 3.1 lakh new accounts, which is a positive sign. Additionally, the bank's loan referral business, which helps people get loans, saw a big increase of 3.5 times, reaching ₹240 crore. This update matters because it shows how the bank is performing and whether it's growing or not, which can be important for people who have invested in the bank.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex extends weekly losses amid renewed Middle East tensions
simplifiedContent: The prices of gold and silver have gone down recently, which means people who own these investments have lost some money. This happened because of concerns about new problems in the Middle East and worries that interest rates might go up. On July 10, gold reached a low point of $4,081 and silver reached a low point of $59.25. As a result, both gold and silver have had a bad week, with their prices going down. This matters because it can affect the overall performance of investments related to gold and silver.

originalTitle: SK Hynix's shares surge 14% in blockbuster US market debut amid AI frenzy
simplifiedContent: SK Hynix, a company that makes semiconductors, had a very successful first day of trading on the US stock market, with its stock price going up by 14%. This happened after the company sold $26.5 billion worth of shares. The strong performance is likely because investors are excited about the potential of semiconductor companies, especially with the current interest in artificial intelligence (AI). This means that people are buying SK Hynix's stock because they think the company will do well in the future. The company's successful debut shows that investors are optimistic about its prospects, which is why the stock price increased so much.
